description: Read retained Agent Inbox suggestions and direct edit outcomes over the last 90 days, newest first. Includes reason, reasonEdited, runTitle, clientName, before/after, outcome and a plain error, plus userEdited {value, note} with the agent’s own suggestedAfter and suggestedReason when the user changed them (for example, you suggested 6000 and the user changed it to 6100), and revisions[]: every later change, oldest first, with at, by (user or agent, plus source and clientName), kind (value or note), action (edited, or restored_to_agent when your original was put back), field, before and after; revisedAt is the latest. Partial duplicates also include failedStep. Filter by accountId, campaignId, since/until, reviewId (run), status, kind or action; use paging.cursor with the same filters for more. Time is resolution time when present, otherwise suggestion creation time. waiting includes applying; failed includes partial outcomes. Direct edit campaign filters match campaign IDs recorded with those edits. Read permission is required and hidden accounts are excluded. Does not call Meta or change anything.

accountId.description: Ad account ID; omit to use the selected account or, if none is selected, all permitted accounts.

cursor.description: Use paging.cursor from the previous page with the same filters.

since.description: Inclusive ISO date or timestamp, within the retained 90-day window.

until.description: Inclusive ISO date or timestamp. A date includes that whole UTC day.

name: ads_list_inbox_history
title: Read Agent Inbox History
